svg.title: Depot predictions and observed computation
svg.desc: Top left: posterior 90 percent intervals for depot intercept-slope correlation for every initial and repair fit, with the synthetic generating correlation marked. Top right: energy BFMI by chain with the 0.3 screen line; labels also report divergence counts. Bottom panels: existing depot zero and new depot predictive median and 90 percent bands at workload deviations minus one, zero and one in ten-job units, for weak and strong information. These depots have different mean workloads. Values, all diagnostics and limitations are also in the result JSON and reading. Passing screens does not prove model truth.
